notes.title: INAZUMA ELEVEN: Victory Road Notice of Release Date Change
notes.notes: [p]Regarding the Release of Inazuma Eleven: Victory Road  [/p][p][/p][p]Inazuma Eleven: Victory Road, which was originally scheduled to be released on Friday, August 22, 2025, has seen a significant increase in content volume beyond our initial projections. As a result, additional time is required to complete voice recordings and multilingual localization. [/p][p][/p][p]To ensure that we deliver a product of the highest possible quality, we have decided to postpone the release date as follows:  [/p][p][/p][p]\[Original Release Date]: August 22, 2025 [/p][p]\[New Release Date]:  November 13, 2025  [/p][p][/p][p]For more information on the latest update and the bonus item offered as an apology, please visit the official website below. [/p][p]■[url="https://www.inazuma.jp/victory-road/en/"]https://www.inazuma.jp/victory-road/en/[/url]  [/p][p][/p][p]We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this delay may cause to those who have been looking forward to the release. We deeply appreciate your continued support and interest in our products.[/p]
